author: David Wilson
title: More Than 1K Join Anti-Israel Boycott - NewsBreak
text:
By David Wilson ,
5 minutes ago Actor Javier Bardem has declared that he will not collaborate with any company supporting Israel in response to the Gaza conflict. He now joins more numerous Hollywood figures in a boycott targeting the Israeli film industry, framing it as a stance against alleged complicity in human rights violations. Bardem urged companies to reconsider their ties with Israel. The boycott explicitly pressures Israeli state-linked institutions and companies to end government policies viewed as oppressive.
Bardem stated, “At the end of August, the IAGS, the International Association of Genocide Scholars who studied thoroughly the concept of genocide, called what is going on in Gaza today a genocide.” Bardem said, “I cannot work with somebody that justifies or supports the genocide. I can’t. It’s as simple as that. We should not be able to do that, in this industry or any industry.”
Bardem is involved in Film Workers for Palestine, which has called attention to Gaza and aims to hold institutions accountable for perceived oppression. Over 1,300 entertainment figures have reportedly joined the boycott.
Bardem said, “Me not getting jobs is absolutely relevant compared to what is going on there.”
Hacks star Hannah Einbinder responded to Bardem by sharing personal ties to those affected. She stressed the distinction between Jewish identity and Israeli state actions. Einbinder said, “I feel like it’s my obligation as a Jewish person to distinguish Jews from the state of Israel because our religion and our culture is such an important and longstanding institution that is really separate to this really ethnonationalist state.”
David Wilson covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
